cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I accept your apology for breaking the vase. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.
